bullets.title: Bessent Eyes ~$1T Treasury General Account for Bond Buybacks
bullets.body: Multiple fintwit sources flagging a CNBC report that Treasury Secretary Bessent could tap nearly $1 trillion from the Treasury General Account to fund expanded bond buybacks, potentially doubling minimum purchases of longer-dated bonds. One account noted this could push long-term yields lower; another quipped 'selling debt to buyback debt' will draw scrutiny at Jackson Hole from Warsh. Treasuries rallied on the news ahead of Friday's Fed Chair Warsh speech.

bullets.title: Jackson Hole / Warsh Speech Friday Looms as Key Rate Catalyst
bullets.body: Markets are framing this week around Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks on Friday, with bond markets seen as potentially 'testing' the Fed ahead of that speech. One account noted 10Y yield sits at 4.71% and that Bessent and Warsh 'hold the key for Treasuries.' Wolfe Research separately warns that rising long-term rates could pressure AI hyperscaler spending via higher borrowing costs.

bullets.title: NVDA Earnings This Week: Cantor and Rosenblatt Both Bullish
bullets.body: Cantor Fitzgerald (Overweight, $350 PT) flags that investors remain underweight NVDA, creating conditions for the stock to move 'very, very fast.' Rosenblatt (Buy, $325 PT) separately expects beats on revenue and profit with focus on Q3 guidance. NVDA earnings are the marquee event in a busy week that also includes CRM, MRVL, INTU, AFRM, TTD, and IREN.

bullets.title: Morgan Stanley's Wilson: Oil Spike Is Biggest Threat to US Equities
bullets.body: MS's Michael Wilson flagged an oil price spike as the primary risk to US stocks, warning it could fuel inflation and force the Fed to respond with higher yields. He recommends energy shares as a portfolio hedge given the current geopolitical setup around Hormuz.

bullets.title: Tech/Nasdaq Under Pressure; US-Canada Trade War in Focus
bullets.body: Nasdaq futures slid 0.4% (S&P futures -0.1%, Dow -0.1%) as tech stocks led declines, with US-Canada trade war tensions cited as an incremental headwind alongside rising yields. One account noted NDX fell 0.6% on Friday with 10Y at 4.71% and Brent crude off 1.6% to $93/bbl.

bullets.title: Wells Fargo Raises MRVL Target to $310 from $240; CLS Upgraded to Buy
bullets.body: Wells Fargo sharply raised its Marvell Technology price target to $310 from $240 ahead of earnings week. Separately, UBS upgraded Celestica (CLS) from Neutral to Buy, raising its PT to $430 from $410.

bullets.title: TSLA Rallied 5% Friday but Stalled at 50-DMA — Key Level This Week
bullets.body: Tesla surged 5% Friday but pulled back right at its 50-day moving average, leaving the 50-DMA as the critical technical level to watch for follow-through this week.

bullets.title: Alibaba AI Models Hit 3B Downloads in 6 Months, Ranked #1 Globally
bullets.body: BABA's open-weight AI models have accumulated more than 3 billion global downloads in the past six months, surpassing Meta, Alphabet, and domestic Chinese peers to rank as the world's #1 AI model by downloads.

bullets.title: XPEV Robotics Spinout Raises $900M+ at $6.3B Valuation; Context for NVDA/AMZN
bullets.body: Xpeng carved out its robotics unit and raised over $900M at a $6.3B+ valuation. One account noted NVDA and AMZN back Agility Robotics at a $2.5B pre-money valuation but called Agility 'further ahead in commercialization,' while Unitree's IPO now commands a ~$35-36B market cap.

bullets.title: AAOI ATM Offering: Holder Stays Bullish Despite Dilution Concern
bullets.body: One account maintaining a large AAOI position pushed back on what it called 'misinterpretations' around the $600M ATM offering, reiterating a bullish stance while criticizing over-reliance on dilutive ATM financing — a concern previously raised with IREN as well.

bullets.title: AI Data Center Power Demand Forecast +165% by 2030
bullets.body: One account highlighted IEA-adjacent forecasts projecting AI data center power demand to grow 165% from current levels by 2030, reinforcing the structural power infrastructure buildout thesis.

bullets.title: Hood (HOOD) Flagged as Fintech Breakout Candidate After Long Base
bullets.body: One trader who has held HOOD since June 2024 flagged the stock as a potential breakout candidate alongside SOFI, NU, and PYPL, noting the fintech sector has been 'trying to bottom forever' with a possible setup forming now.

bullets.title: Tim Cook's Last Full Week as Apple CEO
bullets.body: Multiple accounts noted this is Tim Cook's final full week as Apple CEO — flagged as a calendar milestone worth watching for any transition-related news flow into AAPL.

bullets.title: PDD Q2 Earnings: Revenue Miss, Profit Beat
bullets.body: PDD reported Q2 2026 revenue of 112.4B yuan vs. 115.2B yuan estimate (miss), while adjusted operating profit of 29.1B yuan beat the 28.4B yuan estimate and adjusted EPS of 19.33 yuan beat the 18.51 yuan estimate. Transaction services revenue also missed at 54.7B yuan vs. 58.4B yuan expected.

bullets.title: Fidelity PM Doubles Gold Holdings on Fed Policy Uncertainty
bullets.body: A Fidelity portfolio manager doubled gold holdings over the past three weeks, citing increasing uncertainty over US Fed policy as the primary catalyst — consistent with broader fintwit commentary on gold and Bitcoin rallying as YCC/bond buyback signals emerge.

bullets.title: Oil Market: Crude Bearish, Refined Products Bullish — Total CEO
bullets.body: Total CEO described crude moving through the Strait of Hormuz 'very quietly' today while characterizing the broader oil market as 'bearish for crude, bullish for products.' Shell's CEO separately warned the oil market's 'shock absorber is weakening' amid supply pressures.

bullets.title: Profitable Russell 2000 Stocks Still Outperforming, but Gap Narrowing
bullets.body: Profitable Russell 2000 stocks (positive trailing 12-month EPS) continue to outperform unprofitable peers year-to-date, but the performance gap has been narrowing recently — a potential sign of risk appetite rotation toward lower-quality names.
